description: The same blue square on red as `blur_soft`, blurred by 0.25 of the layer's height -- sixteen pixels at this raster, so the square is gone and what is left is a soft purple gradient with red corners. The large radius is its own case because the sliding window that makes a box blur O(1) is exactly where a wide one would go wrong: an off-by-one in the window, or an edge clamp that let the window run off the layer, is invisible at three pixels and unmissable at sixteen. The corners must not go dark: off-layer reads as the nearest pixel on it, never as black.
